value.body: A BIM modeller builds a detailed digital model of a building that the whole design team works from, and produces drawings and quantities from it. Architecture firms, construction companies and BIM service firms that work for overseas clients hire them. Most of the day is modelling, coordinating with structural and services teams, and fixing clashes.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Arch, B.Tech Civil or a diploma with BIM training

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Revit and similar BIM software, clash-detection tools, AutoCAD

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join as junior modellers in an architecture or BIM services firm, often after a short software course. A portfolio showing a modelled building and its drawings helps more than certificates alone.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many BIM service firms work on overseas projects, so codes and standards may differ from India's.
Next steps: BIM coordinator, BIM manager or a return to design roles.
The work is screen-based and can become repetitive without design responsibility.
